name: fitness-data-bridge
description: Private application bridge for a workspace-owned Fitness database.

interface.longDescription: Fitness Data Bridge reads and writes the workspace-owned Fitness database through bounded adapters for Xunji, SynFit, Apple Calendar, and Apple Health. It consumes governed Fitness v5 sessions but does not own training rules or personal records.
defaultPrompt: Use $fitness-data-bridge to preview or publish one confirmed Fitness v5.1 half-Block release as a unified batch
Use $fitness-data-bridge to refresh Xunji or Apple Health facts into my Fitness workspace
